pbo_caveat: Only four outer folds produce six complementary splits; this is a coarse diagnostic, not a stable PBO estimate.

dsr_proxy.method: expected maximum Sharpe proxy across 13 selectable candidates

negative_controls.interpretation: Randomized training labels produced material OOS lift through exposure gating, so no ML result is distinguishable from a risk-randomization effect.

sample_data_caveats: Longbridge research replay cache is limited to 1,000 common daily sessions.
The stock universe is a current frozen snapshot and excludes historical inactive securities.
Terminal delisting returns, permanent identifiers, and versioned corporate-action lineage are absent.
Adjusted Nasdaq Basic bars are not consolidated SIP or official opening-auction evidence.
The OOS period contains 370 sessions from 2024-12-18 through 2026-06-11, but only one short recent regime sequence.
The formal forward epoch begins 2026-07-20 and currently has zero observations.
capacity_assessment: Blocked. Asset weights are capped at 15%, but no portfolio notional, official-open volume, quoted spread, or matched order ledger exists; percentage-of-ADV capacity cannot be validated.

leader_review.assessment: D06 trades substantial return for a modest Sharpe and drawdown improvement; it did not satisfy the preregistered fold-return acceptance rule.

notes: Workflow semantics passed, but the shuffled-label control, DSR proxy, current-universe provenance, short history, and missing execution evidence block research promotion and paper readiness.
